scope: Offline PubMed EFetch citation-and-abstract XML parser and endpoint builder; no live transport switch or article full-text acquisition.

first_passes.result: Existing frozen bibliographic/page schema suffices. Implement an isolated bounded parser, preserve pubmed identities, reconcile exact requested PMID sets, and reject unsupported book records. Tests written before implementation; pre-implementation Cargo execution was not performed because the shared build target was occupied.

Require finite byte/depth/record/node/field/aggregate-text budgets, no DTD/custom entity resolution, exact structural identity paths, whole-page malformed/unsupported suffix rejection and sanitized errors. Preserve mixed content and explicit mapping limits.

Citation and abstract data are not full article text. Preserve structured labels/order, author components, date precision and identifier agreement in explicit rendering plus metadata; do not invent missing data. Complete manually reviewed ProviderPage goldens must include envelope, pending receipt and independently calculated raw digest.

review_findings: Reject supplied but empty mapped containers rather than silently mapping them as absent.
Map ELocationID DOI values and reject cross-location identifier disagreements.
Compare complete ProviderPage outputs, not only selected record fields.

integration_recheck.change: Elide an unnecessary lifetime to avoid the lexical delimiter check's false positive; add a conservative, unreviewed EFetch policy entry inherited from existing NCBI configuration.
integration_recheck.targeted_static_rechecks: Provider policies and Rust lexical structure both passed after correction; no gate was disabled.

static_baseline_tests.test_first_boundary: Tests preceded implementation and initially reported missing-helper errors; raw baseline output was not preserved, so no baseline log digest is claimed.

rereviews.result: Scalar nesting and declaration grammar findings fixed and re-reviewed. XML baseline checker independently tested. No remaining blocking finding within bounded scope.
Complete page golden and independent raw digest reviewed; mapping documentation matches the supported subset and explicit omissions.

additional_fixed_findings: Leaf-only scalar extraction prevents nested unsupported elements from becoming identities or dates.
XML declarations now validate supported pseudoattributes, order, values and duplicates.
Mapped field cap is accurately documented as post-tree; the aggregate decoded-text bound is enforced before append.
authority_boundary: No network retrieval, live-support claim, current provider-policy or rights approval, historical record/screening migration, release, cutover or archival. Agent review is advisory; owner decisions remain separate.
